notes: Card flags the pole DENSE (13.2% of tokens reach 0.1 of max), max 22.25; top examples are mixed: 'Bureau⟦ of⟧' twice, a line break in a street listing, ' and' in an institution name, an opening quote, ' Booth'. Probes: 'Bureau of' 0.61, 'Department of' 0.36, but an unrelated sentence-final period 0.37 and a street listing 0.34. The test is a best guess that will probably not separate; near misses are agency names without 'of' and 'of' without an agency.
